scope: Links retained exact source-frame GLB reimport contact to existing scoped review. Original empty evidence record and all verdicts remain unchanged; no new anatomy/runtime approval.

label.en: Accepted brain exterior · exact GLB multiview contact
label.zh: 已审阅脑外形·精确 GLB 多视角对照

note.en: Retained prior scoped visual-review contact, newly linked because the earlier catalog record omitted its evidence array. Exact original PNG unchanged; not browser or internal-tissue proof.
note.zh: 保留的既有范围内视觉审查图；先前目录记录漏接证据数组，现补充关联。原 PNG 字节未变，不是浏览器或内部组织验证。

failure.en: The gallery showed only baseline imagery despite retained accepted-candidate evidence.
failure.zh: 已有候选模型审查图被保留，但图库仅展示旧基线图。

text.en: The canonical scoped-review evidence array was empty.
text.zh: 规范范围审查记录的证据数组为空。

fix.en: Add a separate immutable exact-hash evidence link; preserve prior records and verdicts.
fix.zh: 新增独立不可变的精确哈希证据关联，保留旧记录与结论。

retest.en: Source GLB, contact PNG and final-review bindings verified; public display/transport checked separately.
retest.zh: 已核对源 GLB、对照 PNG 及最终审查绑定；公开展示与传输另行检查。

lesson.en: Require at least one candidate-bound image when assessing evidence completeness; baseline images do not substitute.
lesson.zh: 检查证据完整性时，至少应有一张绑定候选模型的图像；旧基线图不能替代。
